jd:
A Tech company in San Diego County is looking to bring on a Full-Stack Developer Internship for this Semester. Looking for someone that has a minimum of 3 years work experience.


Candidate must be in PST or Central Time Zone


Job Location: Remote


Compensation: $1


Responsibilities:


A full stack developer designs, builds, and maintains web applications. They work on both the front-end and back-end of applications, and are responsible for the entire product development lifecycle. 


Design: Create application architectures, user experiences, and technical roadmaps


Develop: Write code, integrate third-party components, and modify existing code


Test: Perform quality assurance and identify performance bottlenecks


Deploy: Deploy code, static files, and databases to the staging environment


Maintain: Ensure products are well-maintained and identify technical debt


Communicate: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, project managers, and architects


Mentor: Provide leadership and mentor junior developers


Skills:


Proficiency in front-end and back-end development


Knowledge of languages, algorithms, and design patterns


Experience with databases, servers, and clients


Experience with frameworks like Angular, React, Vue.js, and Spring boot


Experience with test automation tools like Cucumber and Selenium


Qualifications:


3+ years of professional/projects experience using React Native (Must Have)


Experience in building enterprise-quality products


Experience in designing and implementing scalable web service APIs


Experience in working with Postgres, SQL and NoSQL DB systems


Self-starter, strong work


Schedule:



- Monday to Friday (Min 20-40 hours a Week)


Experience:



- React Native: 3 year (Required) (Must Have)
- API's: 3 year (Required
- Mobile & Web Applications 3 years (Required)


Location:



- Remote


Pay:



- $1


Upon Completion of the Internship Program, interns will be evaluated for a possible paid hired role.
Current internship is with no pay.
fit_why: Requires 3+ years React Native and mobile; unpaid, senior-level
